title: Process CPU parsing
responsibility: Parses process-list rows into CPU totals and recognized application roles without returning command arguments.

inputs.name: cpuProcesses.value
inputs.description: Process-list text with one row per line, where each row is a pid, a parent pid, a cumulative CPU time and a command; the time may carry a day prefix such as 1-02:03:04 and fractional seconds such as 0:12.34. Rows that do not match that shape, including rows ending in a carriage return, are skipped, while a non-numeric time such as 1.2.3 is kept with NaN cpuMs.

inputs.name: cpuProcesses.monitorPid
inputs.description: Pid to classify as Harness regardless of its command; defaults to process.pid (the current process id). It is compared with === against each numeric pid, so a string holding the same digits never matches.

outputs.name: cpuProcesses
outputs.description: One entry per input row that matches the row shape, in input order, with numeric pid, parentPid and cpuMs (cumulative CPU time in milliseconds, NaN for a non-numeric time). role (harness, codex or agent) and label (Harness, Codex app, Codex CLI, Claude, opencode or aider) appear only for recognized rows, and command text is never returned.
